title: Laleli Mosque
scope: Laleli Mosque in Istanbul with the striped late Ottoman stone prayer hall, two single-balcony minarets, raised plinth, arcaded courtyard and fountain. The mosque stands above the historic vaulted bazaar.
limitations: Dome diameter and interior height follow the published 12.50 m and 24.50 m dimensions. Exterior roof thickness, the mosque-floor elevation above the site, the six roof volumes and both minaret heights are estimated.

The model shows the named mosque and its courtyard, stairs, outer galleries and raised masonry base. Subterranean rooms, the adjoining buildings and the separately mapped sultans’ mausoleum are outside the scope.
The outer and courtyard outlines follow the native map. Smaller wall projections, column counts in partially visible bays, masonry bands and glazing lattices are simplified.
